segments.text: All right, listen up, y'all. I'm y'all's substitute teacher, Mr. Garvey. I taught school for 20 years in the inner city, so don't even think about messing with me. Y'all feel me?
Where's Jay Quellin at? No Jay Quellin here?
Okay. So, that's how it's gonna be. Y'all wanna play. Okay, then.
I've got my eye on you, Jay Quellin.
There's n- no Balake here today?
are you out of your goddamn mind?
What? Do you wanna go to war, Balake?
I'm for real. I'm for real. So, you better check yourself.
If one of y'all says some silly-ass name,
this whole class is gonna feel my wrath. Now, D-Nice.
You say your name right, right now.
A. Aaron, where are you? Where is A. Aaron right now?
No A. Aaron, huh? Well, you better be sick, dead, or mute, A. Aaron.
Why didn't you answer me the first time I said it, huh?
I'm just, you know, I'm just asking. You know, I said it, like, four times, so why didn't you say it the first time I said A. Aaron?
You done messed up, A. Aaron. Now take your ass on down to O-Shag Hennessey's office right now and tell him exactly what you did.
Get out of my goddamn classroom before I break my foot off in your ass. Insubordinate
